# B11 — Integrated owner journeys and honest release report

[START](../../guide/00-START.md). Depends: B10. Outcome: all owner journeys pass and the release states exactly what is and is not ready.

Read `docs/guide/06-EXPERIENCE-TESTS.md` (journey catalog J01–J12), `docs/MADHURITA_BUILD_BOOK.md` (release gate), every prior B00–B10 gate, and `tests/journeys/` (planned). Load only functions for the active slice. No new application behavior in this task beyond journey wiring and reporting.

Planned files: `tests/journeys/*` (J01–J12 integration suite), `docs/RELEASE_REPORT.md` (generated per release).

## Slices

- **s1:** Journeys J01–J06 integration. Wire a suite that exercises stable IDs J01 (Hinglish greeting with stored address), J02 (open jobs → priority/deadline/blocker), J03 (accepted brief job → real artifact), J04 (running job → actual steps/artifact version), J05 (hide/close/reopen → job continues, latest snapshot), J06 (crash after tool effect before acknowledgement → reconciled, no duplicate logical effect). Use real disposable SQLite and production services; mocks only at external boundaries for deterministic failures. Never edit journey assertions to make broken behavior pass.
- **s2:** Journeys J07–J12 integration. Cover J07 (cancel vs completion race → monotonic legal outcome with receipt), J08 (correction → next response follows), J09 (quota/network unavailable → no paid call, useful blocked/qualified route), J10 (explain failure → fresh evidence, affected capability, bounded recovery), J11 (interrupt speech → obsolete audio stops, job remains), J12 (unseen wording/changed sources → general logic, not fixture answers). Include hide-vs-cancel, reconnect cursor dedup and unsupported-tool cases. Zero false completion, duplicated effects or unauthorized dispatch across the acceptance suite.
- **s3:** Release evidence and report. Run existing `typecheck`, `lint`, full test suite and `build`; then the full journey suite. Generate `docs/RELEASE_REPORT.md` recording: tested revision + dirty-file fingerprint, platform, hardware, model/provider versions, scenario seeds, test/artifact hashes, commands/exit codes, timestamps, artifact paths, per-journey evidence, p50/p95 latency (work acknowledgement, first audio, barge-in), paired blind voice ratings vs owner-chosen baseline, offline limitations and blocking gaps. On any gap emit `partial`/`blocked` with the exact missing piece — do not claim a general-intelligence release.

Each slice must first exhibit the defect (a journey or evidence field missing). Do not bundle all three into one small-model prompt.

## Gate

All J01–J12 pass with zero observed false completion, duplicated logical effects or unauthorized dispatch across the acceptance suite — this is a finite-test observation, not a claim of zero possible failures in the world. Release evidence exists for every required field; voice quality is backed by paired blind ratings, not an LLM grading itself. If any journey, health check or feasibility is blocked, the report is labeled `partial`/`blocked` naming exactly what is absent, and the release is not marked ready. Owner sign-off on subjective experience is required.

Next: none. The next product expansion is a recorded owner decision with a new task, not a claim applied at boot.
